about.title: About me
about.description: I'm a Junior Software Developer focused on Generative AI and full‑stack development. I work with Azure OpenAI, LangChain/LangGraph, Copilot Studio, Power Automate, and build apps in Python and TypeScript. At Algar Telecom I deliver AI solutions like a real‑time Sales Copilot for call assistance, an invoice validation system (Billy) that cut review time by 96%, cost optimizations over 40%, and robust LLM benchmarking to ensure accuracy.

content.title: Sales Copilot
content.description: AI assistant for Algar Telecom’s SMB sales reps. On Azure OpenAI, it listens to customer calls, analyzes conversation cues in real time, and suggests tailored arguments and offers based on profile and pain points, boosting sales effectiveness.

content.title: Billy
content.description: GenAI app to automate analysis and validation of telecom invoices by extracting and interpreting contract data. Combining Azure OpenAI and RPA, it reduced manual review time by 96% and saved millions in operational costs.
